from pathlib import Path
import json, re
bridge=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-chat-bridge'
bus=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-command-bus'
router=(bridge/'command_router.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8') if (bridge/'command_router.py').exists() else ''
poller=(bus/'command_bus_poller.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8') if (bus/'command_bus_poller.py').exists() else ''
script=(bridge/'prediction-chat-wake.user.js').read_text(encoding='utf-8') if (bridge/'prediction-chat-wake.user.js').exists() else ''
m=re.search(r'@version\s+([^\s]+)',script)
print('ROUTER_ACTIVE_PAGE='+str('PredictionChatCommandRouter/0.3-active-page' in router))
print('POLLER_ACTIVE_PAGE='+str('active_page_required' in poller and 'ACTIVE_PAGE_FILE' in poller))
print('USERSCRIPT_VERSION='+(m.group(1) if m else 'MISSING'))
print('USERSCRIPT_PRESENCE='+str('/presence' in script and 'document.hasFocus()' in script))
active=bridge/'active_page.json'
if active.exists():
    try:
        obj=json.loads(active.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        print('ACTIVE_PAGE_EXISTS=True')
        print('ACTIVE_PAGE_ACTIVE='+str(bool(obj.get('active'))))
        print('ACTIVE_PAGE_CHAT='+str(obj.get('chat_id') or ''))
        print('ACTIVE_PAGE_CONSUMER='+str(obj.get('consumer_id') or ''))
    except Exception as exc:
        print('ACTIVE_PAGE_PARSE='+type(exc).__name__)
else:
    print('ACTIVE_PAGE_EXISTS=False')
